s1.desc: a dining nook drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: Pax alone at the table nibbling a seaweed hand roll; slow continuous push in for the whole shot (chair and table drift ~0.6 px/frame, ~32 px by the end)

spans.view: with a round cream table on a glass pedestal and two wooden chairs

beats.text: Pax holds his seaweed hand roll and chews while Polly sits beside him, flippers clasped under her chin, sparkles twinkling around her
Polly closes her eyes in a dreamy smile while Pax keeps holding his hand roll
Polly opens her eyes wide with an adoring, starry look as Pax stares ahead

spans.notes: Table bbox identical in every frame 53-81 (camera locked).
Polly close-up behind the table, sparkles; locked for 12 frames before the push starts
slow push in on Polly (table drifts ~1.5 px/frame from 94 to the cut)

Two-shot at the table: Polly leans in with puckered lips, then dives past Pax and bites his hand roll. Slow continuous zoom in: the table's width grows from 918 to 958 px (about 4%) between 131 and 192; settled from 192. Good action, but the zoom is real, so dropped (D3).
locked 13 frames: Polly eating the stolen hand roll, Pax rearing up
fast pan right and down following Pax as he leaps onto Polly and they tumble to the floor
locked 16 frames: Pax lying on top of Polly on the floor, hugging her
